submissionFailed: Submission did not complete normally. Inspect the destination before restarting; the previous submission will not be retried.
title: New note title (without .md)
confirm: I have reviewed this content and want to apply it
chooseHelp: Choose a built-in template or a saved Markdown file from the configured folder.
moreHelp: More templates are available on the next page.
truncated: The host truncated this listing. Narrow the template folder to find more files.
expired: This form has expired. Open the template command again.
workspaceChanged: Workspace changed. Reopen the template command.
busy: Please wait for the current operation.
sourceRequired: Switch to Markdown source mode with an active cursor before inserting a template.
stale: The editor changed. Reopen the template command; no automatic retry will occur.
invalidTitle: Enter a non-empty file title without directory separators.
insertHelp: Insert at the captured cursor, or after the captured selection. Existing content is preserved.
previewTruncated: Preview truncated at 12,000 characters. The full content will be used.
existing: Same-name note already exists; contents were preserved
notOpened: The file exists but could not be opened; inspect it before retrying
setting.folderHelp: Saved Markdown templates, searched recursively. Grant notes.read and notes.list access to this folder. Two ways to customize: save a hand-written Markdown template in the template folder, or click Create template to write its body and configure fields in a form. Both produce editable .md files using the same syntax.
setting.destinationHelp: Workspace-relative output folder. Same-name notes are never overwritten.
permission.editorRead: Read the active note title and selected text.
permission.editorWrite: Insert at a captured position with revision checks.
permission.read: Read saved Markdown templates from the template folder.
permission.list: List templates in the configured folder.
permission.create: Create notes in the output folder.
permission.open: Open the newly created or existing destination note.
designer.methods: Two ways to customize: save a hand-written Markdown template in the template folder, or click Create template to write its body and configure fields in a form. Both produce editable .md files using the same syntax.
designer.permissionHelp: To use the creator, grant the optional notes.write permission only for your template folder. Read and list access are still needed to select saved templates. Existing files are never overwritten.
designer.permission: Create new Markdown templates in the template folder; this plugin never supplies an existing-file revision or overwrites existing templates.
designer.bodyHelp: Write Markdown with built-in variables such as {{title}}, {{date}}, {{time}} and {{selection}}. For custom fields, put {{field.topic}} in the body; the next step configures its label, type and default. Do not write JSON metadata here.
designer.name: Template file name (without .md)
designer.label: Display label
designer.fieldsHelp: Configure the fields found in your Markdown. Up to six fields are shown per page; repeated variables share one field.
designer.confirm: Save this as a new template file
designer.saved: Template saved. Select it the next time you insert or create a note
designer.invalidBody: Enter a safe file name and a non-empty body of at most 16,000 characters.
designer.noHeader: The creator generates field metadata for you. Enter only the Markdown body, or edit an existing template file directly.
name: Dynamic Templates
description: Markdown templates with variables, custom fields and safe note insertion.
